proposition.claim:
The negative physical velocity correction yields nonzero leading symplectic pairing and allows arbitrary q0 in the trapping interval.

Lemmas8.10-8.11 already prove ||r^p D phi||_2 for 0<=p<=2 with the displayed decay.

Euclidean R5 volume is comparable to geometric volume on Sigma_tau at large rho; Lemma8.14 holds with the resulting norms.
